name: SousShift AI
facts: SousShift AI builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Say it 'SOO-shift', like sous chef.
Guests scan a QR code and the app opens in their phone browser. There is no app store and nothing to download.
Three plans, per restaurant: Basic $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth $3,500 setup + $650/mo (most popular), Done-for-you $4,000 setup + $950/mo.
AI Text Assistant is $75/mo per location. AI Voice Host + Text is $150/mo per location. Both are month to month.
Online Ordering + Delivery add-on is $300/mo flat, or $200/mo + 5% of the food on each order. It is coming soon.
Social & SEO Growth is $1,000/mo. The Everything bundle (Done-for-you + Social & SEO) is $4,000 setup + $1,800/mo.
Pay setup in full, split 50/50 (half at signing, half at Go-Live), or flexible (from $750 down, the rest spread over 12 months with no extra charge).
Minimum term is 3 months, then month to month with 30 days' written notice. Your customer list is yours.

Results promise: if there is no 30-day period in your first 3 months where the app brought back at least 30 tracked return visits, your next 2 monthly payments are waived. It is not a promise of sales.
Contact: secondshiftai@gmail.com, Instagram @SousShiftAi, or the 24/7 AI sales line (424) 296-3303 answered by Nia. The line is calls only.
Free sample app: tell us about your business (about 3 minutes), Antidote builds it, and you see it on your phone. No card, no pressure.

Real demos: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game), Nalu Vida (surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match), Lucky Dragon (Hibachi Catch), plus a mechanic app, ice cream truck app, food truck app and gym app.
Melody Bar & Grill is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. The other demos are samples built to show what we make.

qa.a: We build branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Guests scan a QR, play your game, join your rewards and come back.
It's 'SOO-shift', like sous chef.
Restaurants, bars, cafés, food and ice cream trucks, bakeries, auto shops, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes and retail shops.
Your own branded app with a 4K photo menu, a custom game, points and rewards, referrals, a weekly leaderboard, your customer list, and a QR print kit. Hosting and support are included.
Per restaurant: Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth is $3,500 + $650/mo, and Done-for-you is $4,000 + $950/mo.

Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo. You get a branded app with ordering and table QR, a 4K menu with 3D dishes, 12 languages, points and rewards, referrals, a custom game with a weekly leaderboard, your customer list, a print kit design and promo video. You send your own promotions.

Growth is $3,500 setup + $650/mo. It's everything in Basic plus Google review prompts, nearby alerts, the AI Text Assistant, automatic birthday and 'we miss you' texts, and missed-call text-back. We also place your print order.
Done-for-you is $4,000 setup + $950/mo. It's everything in Growth plus the AI Voice Host answering your phone, and we run your texting and marketing for you.
Basic if you're happy to send your own promotions. Growth if you want guests brought back automatically. Done-for-you if you want us to run it and answer your phone.

qa.q: What do I have to do on each plan?
qa.a: Basic: you send your texts and promotions and print the stickers. Growth: bring-back texts run on their own and we order your printing. Done-for-you: we run the texting and marketing and you approve.

qa.q: How much is it for the first year?
qa.a: Year one is Basic $7,200, Growth $11,300 or Done-for-you $15,400 (setup plus 12 months), before any add-ons.
There's a 3-month minimum, then it's month to month. Either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice, and email counts.
Yes, after the 3-month minimum you can cancel with 30 days' written notice. AI add-ons are month to month from day one, and your customer list goes with you.

qa.q: Can I pay the setup in installments?
qa.a: Yes, three ways: all at signing, split 50/50 (half at signing and half at Go-Live), or the flexible plan from $750 down.

qa.q: How does the flexible payment plan work?
qa.a: Put at least $750 down, and the rest of the setup is split into 12 equal pieces added to your monthly, with no extra charge. After 12 months it drops back to your normal monthly.

qa.q: What would the flexible plan cost monthly?
qa.a: With $750 down, Basic is about $537.50/mo, Growth about $879/mo and Done-for-you about $1,221/mo for 12 months. Then they drop to $350, $650 or $950.
You pay 50% of the setup when you sign and 50% when your app is delivered (Go-Live). The monthly starts the day you sign.

qa.q: Can I pay by card in full?
qa.a: Yes. You can pay the setup plus your first month by card through Stripe, then the monthly runs automatically. Ask us for your link.
The monthly starts the day you sign. If any payment is more than 15 days late, service can pause until it's paid.

The contract adds a performance share: 10% of only the app sales over $3,000 in a month. For example, $5,000 in app sales = $200. Under $3,000 you owe nothing extra, and alcohol, tax and tips never count.
We have a results promise: if there's no 30-day period in your first 3 months with at least 30 tracked return visits, your next 2 monthly payments are waived. It's not a promise of sales.
You do. You get full access and a CSV export anytime, and a complete export within 10 days if you ever leave. We never sell it or use it for another business.

AI Text Assistant $75/mo, AI Voice Host + Text $150/mo, Online Ordering + Delivery $300/mo (coming soon), and Social & SEO Growth $1,000/mo. The Sports Bar Package, Games Pack and 3D Digital Menu are quoted on request.

qa.q: Are the AI agents included in my plan?
qa.a: The Text Assistant is included in Growth and Done-for-you, and the Voice Host is included in Done-for-you. On Basic you can add them for $75 or $150 a month.

qa.q: Can I upgrade from Text to Voice on Growth?
qa.a: Yes. Voice + Text is $150/mo and Growth already includes the $75 Text Assistant, so the upgrade is $75/mo more.

qa.q: What are the AI texting and call limits?
qa.a: Text includes 1,000 texts a month, then $0.03 a text. Voice includes 750 call minutes plus 1,000 texts, then $0.15 a minute. We tell you before you go over.

qa.q: Does the AI sound like a robot?
qa.a: It uses a natural, modern AI voice, and it says it's an AI if asked. You can try Kira (Melody Bar & Grill) or Kai (Nalu Vida) on our agents page, or call (424) 296-3303 to hear Nia.

qa.q: What if the AI doesn't know the answer?
qa.a: It doesn't guess. It tells the customer a person will follow up and texts you or your manager the question with the customer's name and number.
It collects reservation requests (name, party size, date, time, phone) and sends them to your staff to confirm. It doesn't book into your system on its own.

qa.q: What phone number does the AI use?
qa.a: Your existing number through call forwarding, or a new local number we set up for you. We walk you through it.

qa.q: How long does AI setup take?
qa.a: We load your hours, menu, specials and FAQs and test it with you. Texting needs carrier registration, which usually takes a few days. We handle both.
Yes, we follow the rules for you. Promotional texts only go to opted-in people, STOP is honored automatically, and nothing promotional goes out outside 8 AM to 9 PM.

qa.q: Is the AI add-on a contract?
qa.a: No. AI agents are month to month per location, and you can switch tiers or cancel anytime.

qa.q: I have more than one location.
qa.a: Prices are per restaurant, and the 3,000 performance-share test is counted per location. Contact us and we'll total it for you.

qa.q: I'm already a client. Do my prices change?
qa.a: No. Signed deals keep their terms. The listed prices are for new restaurants.

First a free sample built from your menu and photos. Then we build your app with your logo, colors, game and rewards. Then QR codes go on your tables and window, and guests scan, play, earn and return.

qa.q: How long does it take to launch?
qa.a: Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo. Your free sample is usually ready the same day.

qa.q: How does the free sample work?
qa.a: Tell us about your business and add a few menu items and 2-6 photos, about 3 minutes. Antidote builds your app and you play it on your phone. No card, no pressure.

qa.q: What do you need from me?
qa.a: Your menu with prices, photos, your logo and any deals you want to run. We handle the build, hosting and updates.

qa.q: How do I book a call or get a demo?
qa.a: Call the 24/7 line at (424) 296-3303, email secondshiftai@gmail.com, or DM @SousShiftAi on Instagram. Or build your free sample right on our site.

qa.q: Can I just talk to someone?
qa.a: Yes. Call (424) 296-3303 any time and Nia, SousShift's AI guide, will explain the plans and add-ons, answer your questions and connect you to Antidote.

qa.q: Tell me about Gritz N Wafflez.
qa.a: Gritz N Wafflez in Koreatown has the 'Order Up!' game where you run the kitchen and serve plates. The top weekly score wins a karaoke shoutout. It's a sample build, still in the works.
StormBurger (Inglewood and Long Beach) has the 'Storm Run' 3D driving game, a menu with real photos and 3D food, and rewards with weekly prizes.
Churrito Loco in South Gate has 'Loco Match', a Candy-Crush style puzzle game with their mascot. It's a demo sample.
Lucky Dragon in Compton is a hibachi demo with the 'Hibachi Catch' dragon game and a build-your-hibachi-plate menu. It's a demo sample.

qa.q: Do you have a mechanic app demo?
qa.a: Yes. Customers say or tap what's wrong, see a sample price or ask for a quote, check tire stock, book and pay by QR. There are shop views for repair, tire, quick lube, body and detailing.

qa.q: Do you have an ice cream truck demo?
qa.a: Yes. Customers see a live truck map, 'Truck's on your street' alerts and an ETA. They also get check-in rewards: 5 check-ins earns 10% off or an extra scoop.

qa.q: Do you have a food truck demo?
qa.a: Yes. It has a live map, today's stops, order-ahead timed so food comes off the grill as the customer walks up, and an owner view with a cook queue.

qa.q: Do you have a gym demo?
qa.a: Yes, ALL-ONE GYM in Lakewood: a member app with QR check-in, a workout plan and 10-for-10 prizes.

qa.q: Do you work with lawyers or bail bonds?
qa.a: We have sample legal apps: Courtroom Practice and Court Companion with court dates, reminders and lawyer tasks, which can carry a firm's brand. Ask us for details.
Melody Bar & Grill is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. The other apps are demo samples that show what we build, and yours gets the same treatment.
Guests earn points on visits and orders, level up from Regular to VIP to Legend, and get a birthday treat. Points unlock rewards you choose.

qa.q: How do weekly contests and leaderboards work?
qa.a: Guests play your custom game, and the top score on the weekly leaderboard wins a prize you set. The board resets each week, and there's a free daily spin and a weekly giveaway.
Guests get an invite-a-friend code. When the friend joins, both get something, and you can see who brings in the most people.
You do. You choose the prizes and rewards, like a free item or a discount. Gritz N Wafflez, for example, gives a karaoke shoutout.

qa.q: What is the gold loyalty card?
qa.a: Each member gets a card ID staff can scan, plus a live reward pass with a moving display that can't be screenshotted.

qa.q: How do you stop fake points?
qa.a: Scout, our fraud guard, catches point farming, duplicate accounts and fake receipt claims before anyone is rewarded.

qa.q: Can I reward my first members?
qa.a: Yes. An early-bird gift or raffle drawing rewards your first members and fills your list fast.

qa.q: What kind of game would I get?
qa.a: A custom game themed to your food or business, with your logo and often you as a cartoon character. Guests play while they wait, and hitting the prize score wins something.

qa.q: How do guests get the app?
qa.a: They scan the QR on a table, window or receipt and it opens in their phone browser. There's no app store and nothing to download.

qa.q: Can guests save it to their home screen?
qa.a: Yes. On iPhone tap Share then Add to Home Screen, and on Android tap the menu then Install app.
No account or app store. They join your rewards with their phone or email.

qa.q: What's in the QR print kit?
qa.a: Designed QR table stickers, a 24x36 window poster and numbered table cards, ready to print. Real examples are on the Melody and Nalu Vida kits.
On Basic you order and place them using our print-ready files. On Growth and Done-for-you we place the order and bill the print cost at cost.
About $100 to $165 per restaurant for 50 to 100 stickers, a poster and 50 table cards, based on published prices.

qa.q: Can guests order from the table?
qa.a: Yes. Guests send their order from their seat after scanning the table QR. Card payment ordering is the coming-soon add-on.

qa.q: Does it work with Toast or Square?
qa.a: Yes, it works with any register, including Toast, Square and Clover. Nothing to install, and staff look up members by phone or code.

qa.q: I already have Owner.com or an ordering app.
qa.a: Keep it. We add what ordering apps don't, like a game guests open daily, rewards for dine-in visits, and no app download. Delivery stays as it is today.
The menu works in 12 languages, including Español, 中文, 한국어, Հայերեն and Русский, one tap away. The staff app is in English and Spanish.
A bilingual (English and Spanish) training app with step-by-step screenshots, a Listen button and a quiz. It holds no customer data.

qa.q: What does the owner back office do?
qa.a: It shows members, visits, rewards and prices in one place. You decide what each employee can see and change, and every change is logged.

qa.q: Can I text or email my customers?
qa.a: Yes. Every signup is saved to your customer list, and you can email your list on every plan. Growth and Done-for-you add automatic birthday, 'we miss you' and holiday texts, sent only to people who opted in.

qa.q: Will it get me more Google reviews?
qa.a: Growth and Done-for-you include Google review prompts, nudging happy guests to leave a review.
Your dishes shown with sharp photos, with signature dishes in 3D, easy to update. Menu and price changes are handled on request.

qa.q: Do you update the app for me?
qa.a: Yes. Hosting, updates and support are included, and we update menus and prices on request.
Yes. Holiday themes like Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas switch on and off by themselves.
Yes. Every plan includes a promo video, plus exposure on Antidote's food-review audience. We don't promise view counts or customers.

qa.a: Ice cream trucks: Single Scoop $99 setup + $29/mo, Double Scoop $299 (or $199 for the first 10 trucks) + $50/mo, Sundae $599 + $129/mo for up to 3 trucks. The same plans work for food trucks, with ordering ahead from Double Scoop up.

qa.q: What does an auto shop or other business pay?
qa.a: Mechanic pricing is set per shop, so email us or call (424) 296-3303 for a quote. Other non-restaurant pricing isn't listed, so we quote it per business.
No. We don't promise sales or follower counts, only the results promise on tracked return visits. Estimates on the site are estimates.

qa.q: What types of businesses do you build for?
qa.a: Restaurants, bars, cafés, food and ice cream trucks, desserts, bakeries, auto shops, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes, retail, boba and coffee, pizza, tacos, BBQ and hibachi. Tell us your type and we'll describe your app and game.

qa.q: What if my business isn't listed?
qa.a: Ask us. We build custom apps and games for local businesses, and you can pick 'Something else' on the free sample form.
